summary: Ultra Clean Holdings filed an 8-K announcing entry into a sales agreement with UBS Securities, Barclays Capital, Craig-Hallum, and Oppenheimer to sell up to $400 million of common stock through an at-the-market offering. The ATM is an ordinary equity distribution program, not a special-situation event. Agents receive up to 3.0% commission. Sales are discretionary and made under an existing Form S-3 shelf. No price, premium, or strategic transaction terms were disclosed. This is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not an activist, restructuring, or acquisition event. Watch for future sales but no risk-arb angle applies.
